title: 云依助手 0.13.16 · 桌面依依恢复与举牌修复
releaseNotes: Removed the toolbox introduction banner and sidebar subtitle. Restored centered reminder placards, including the ten-second test while the workspace is open. Closing, hiding or minimizing the workspace restores the desktop pet; reopening restores minimized windows and synchronizes WebView2 visibility. Manual hiding is kept separate. Idle edge-tucking follows the configured system inactivity threshold, works after reminder presentation, and retains visible character content. Full offline WebView2 and VC++ prerequisites remain included for Windows 10/11 x64 USB distribution.
